hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */.env|*/.env.*|*/src-tauri/gen/*|*/Cargo.lock|*/pnpm-lock.yaml|*/src-tauri/capabilities/*.json) echo "BLOCKED: $f is a protected path (secret, generated artifact, lockfile, or Tauri capability grant). Ask the user to edit it manually." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
